environment: Isolated local source copy and disposable PostgreSQL database; synthetic data only; email and workers disabled.
method: Chromium, @axe-core/playwright 4.13.0; wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa, wcag22aa tags; viewport height 1000. Additional interaction probes exercise actual forms and navigation.
limitations: No live deployment, production timing, real provider delivery, real MFA enrollment, exhaustive permission or mutation testing, or screen-reader usability certification. A development compilation restart caused one temporary offline fallback; the saved report was retested successfully.
